connector.name: Octopus Blackboard
connector.registryDescription: Shared memory & coordination for AI coding agents - a blackboard, not an orchestrator.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package octopus-blackboard. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the octoryn account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: OCTOBOARD_AGENT
env.description: Identity the server writes under, e.g. "cursor" or "claude-code". Defaults to "anon".

env.name: OCTOBOARD_DIR
env.description: Explicit board directory. Omitted → the server discovers the nearest .octoboard/ by walking up from the working directory.
